ai_summary: Aegis Logistics Limited's board has approved the significant acquisition of an 89.8% stake in Tristar Holdings Limited, a large and profitable global liquid logistics provider, for US$ 809 million in cash. This strategic move is expected to immediately contribute to Aegis's profitability and vastly expand its international operations in the liquid fuels infrastructure sector. A key watchpoint is the substantial cash consideration, with financing details not yet disclosed, and the lengthy completion timeline into Q4 FY27 which may introduce integration and regulatory complexities.
